observations.name: Process Injection
observations.justification: The malware string 'OpenProcess' was found in the binary. This string is characteristic of Process Injection behavior. The presence of this specific string alone (no other Process Injection-related string corroborates it) indicates the malware has capabilities associated with this technique, but with less certainty than a corroborated combination would.

observations.name: System Information Discovery
observations.justification: The API function 'GetUserNameW' is imported by the binary. This API is commonly used to perform System Information Discovery. Importing this function alone (no other System Information Discovery-related import corroborates it) indicates the malware has the capability to execute this technique, but with less certainty than a corroborated combination would.

observations.name: Privilege Escalation
observations.justification: The API function 'OpenProcessToken' is imported by the binary. This API is commonly used to perform Privilege Escalation. Importing this function alone (no other Privilege Escalation-related import corroborates it) indicates the malware has the capability to execute this technique, but with less certainty than a corroborated combination would.
